notes: All records with provenance REAL are copied from the cached Cresci-2017 interim tables without alteration.
Records with provenance SYNTHETIC_TEST are explicit defensive positive controls, not real accounts or empirical observations.

Numeric ids (user_id, post_id, target_id) are carried as strings.
Accounts are split into ten disjoint partitions; source communities are spread across partitions on purpose.
label 0 = human, label 1 = bot, as recorded in the source table.
source_group is the original Cresci-2017 directory the account came from, keyed off the source label.
